free_tier.stated: no free tier; the plans start at JPY 460 a month for 512 MB and JPY 763 a month for 1 GB

retention.stated: the instance persists while the monthly plan is paid; the page prints the renewal price beside the first-term price

egress.terms: data transfer JPY 0 and 無制限 (unlimited) on the configuration examples on the plan page

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: JPY 460 a month for 512 MB is the cheapest Japanese floor found, and the JPY 360 coupon is about 78 percent of one month on that plan, so the coupon is one free month at the bottom of the ladder rather than a trial of the useful sizes.

limits.value: no traffic quota stated; transfer is 無制限 (unlimited)

limits_note: The coupon is JPY 360 once, so it buys days rather than a month, and the server keeps billing after the coupon is gone unless it is deleted.
binding_note: neither traffic nor time binds: the 1 GB of RAM is what fails first, and the 512 MB plan at JPY 460 exists precisely because 1 GB is the useful floor

identity_cost.detail: email signup and a payment method: VISA, MasterCard, JCB, American Express and Diners Club, plus PayPal, Amazon Pay, convenience-store payment and bank transfer through the prepaid 'ConoHaチャージ' wallet. American Express and Diners Club are restricted to Japan residents, which implies the other cards and PayPal are not. No Japanese phone or ID step is documented on the payment or flow pages read; the signup form itself was not fetched

evidence.proved: the campaign page states, in Japanese, that a JPY 360 coupon is given to accounts newly registered from that page with a credit card registered, and publishes a table converting the coupon into free days per plan: about 11.5 days on 512 MB, 7.9 on 1 GB, 4.1 on 2 GB, 2.3 on 4 GB, 1.1 on 12 GB, 14.9 hours on 24 GB, 7.4 hours on 48 GB, 3.7 hours on 96 GB and 2.8 hours on 128 GB; GPU types are excluded; the campaign ended 2026-10-01 16:00
the support FAQ states, in Japanese, that there is no free trial service, and points to a referrer programme instead
the pricing page gives the ladder in Japanese yen: 512 MB with 1 core and 30 GB SSD at JPY 460 a month on hourly billing, and 1 GB with 2 cores and 100 GB at JPY 763 a month
